digest.component_or_area: capability registry and optional dependency enforcement
propositions: A standalone, immutable stdlib-only semantic capability registry must validate 14 capabilities (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback postures) against declared packaging extras without importing probe modules.

Stable top-level commands and help must remain accessible in a no-extras wheel; only selected execution boundaries (after mode/backend selection) enforce capability checks and emit actionable errors for error postures.
Lean diagnostic and read-only modes (e.g., audit show, non-agent review workflows) must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities or their packaging extras.
Domain components retain control over unavailable, abstain, and fallback result payloads and logging; the registry provides only metadata and install hints, never manufacturing domain results.
Separate entry points (rebar-mcp, review-bot) consume capability metadata and are registry capabilities but do not appear in the top-level CLI route registry.
